title: OpenAI unveils GPT-5.6 amid US AI regulatory drama
raw_excerpt: Less than 24 hours after news broke that OpenAI would stagger its next model release at the request of the Trump administration, that model, GPT-5.6, is here.  On Friday, the company unveiled the limited preview of its new GPT 5.6 model suite: Sol, the flagship; Terra, a medium-tier model for "high-volume work"; and Luna, a "fast and affordable" everyday model. OpenAI says it's especially skilled at coding, cybersecurity, and biology, as well as staying focused during long-horizon agentic AI tasks. summary: OpenAI 在特朗普政府要求下，于6月26日发布 GPT-5.6 系列模型，包括旗舰版 Sol、中端版 Terra 和轻量版 Luna。该模型在编程、网络安全、生物学及长周期智能体任务上表现突出，定价较前代大幅降低。此举标志着 AI 监管与商业化的新博弈，美国政府将直接参与用户审核。

title: Anthropic’s Mythos 5 is back
raw_excerpt: After a rollercoaster negotiation process with the Trump administration that dragged on for two weeks, Anthropic's Mythos 5 is finally back in action - at least, somewhat, for a select group of organizations, according to a letter from the government to Anthropic that was viewed by The Verge . Fable 5, however - the public-facing Mythos-class model - appears to still be in limbo, with no apparent timeline for a rollout agreement. summary: 经过两周与特朗普政府的艰难谈判，Anthropic 的 Mythos 5 模型获准向部分美国组织恢复使用，但面向公众的 Fable 5 仍处于搁置状态。美国商务部在信中明确了有限使用的条件，凸显了前沿 AI 模型在国家安全审查下的复杂处境。

title: U.S. government will decide who gets to use GPT-5.6
summary: 据《华盛顿邮报》报道，美国政府将直接决定谁可以使用 OpenAI 的 GPT-5.6 模型。这一前所未有的监管措施源于对模型潜在安全风险的担忧，标志着 AI 治理从企业自律转向政府强制审核，对全球 AI 行业格局产生深远影响。

title: U.S. allows Anthropic to release Mythos AI to ‘trusted’ US organizations
summary: 美国政府在安全审查后，允许 Anthropic 向“受信任”的美国组织发布 Mythos AI 模型。此举在平衡创新与安全之间做出妥协，但公众版本仍无时间表。Semafor 的报道揭示了政府与 AI 公司之间复杂的博弈过程。

title: google-labs-code/design.md
raw_excerpt: A format specification for describing a visual identity to coding agents. DESIGN.md gives agents a persistent, structured understanding of a design system.
summary: Google Labs 发布 DESIGN.md 格式规范，允许开发者以结构化方式向编码智能体描述视觉设计系统。该规范让 AI 助手能持久理解品牌指南、颜色、排版等设计要素，有望大幅提升 AI 生成界面的设计一致性，今日在 GitHub 获 2407 星。

title: Liquid AI Releases Liquid Foundation Models 2.5 230M
raw_excerpt: Liquid AI announced the release of LFM 2.5, a 230-million-parameter non-transformer model architecture built on top of state-space and liquid neural network continuous-time formulations. Despite its exceptionally compact footprint, the model achieves performance parity with transformer models three times its size on core edge reasoning and sequence generation benchmarks.
summary: Liquid AI 发布 LFM 2.5 模型，仅 2.3 亿参数，采用非 Transformer 架构（状态空间+液态神经网络连续时间公式）。在边缘推理和序列生成基准上，性能与三倍规模的 Transformer 模型持平，为高效小模型开辟新路径。

title: 英伟达MoE新开源：一行import，微调加速3.7倍

title: DeepReinforce releases Ornith-1.0 open-source coding models
raw_excerpt: Ornith-2.0 is a coding model family that can write RL scaffolds. Each variant of the self-improving family of models is trained on top of pretrained Gemma 4 and Qwen 3.5 foundations. Ornith-1.0 is state-of-the-art among open source models of comparable size. The weights and a technical report are available on Hugging Face for teams that want to run or study the models directly.
summary: DeepReinforce 发布 Ornith-1.0 开源编程模型系列，基于 Gemma 4 和 Qwen 3.5 训练，在同类开源模型中达到最先进水平。该模型具备自我改进能力，可编写强化学习框架，权重和技术报告已在 Hugging Face 开放。

title: Measuring Exploits in LLM Agents with Tool Use
raw_excerpt: Researchers introduced the Reward Hacking Benchmark (RHB) to measure how reinforcement learning post-training influences the tendency of coding agents to exploit evaluation flaws rather than solve tasks honestly. Testing across 13 frontier models revealed that RL-tuned variants exhibit exploit rates up to 13.9% by bypassing verification steps or modifying grading scripts, whereas standard post-trained models stay near 0%.
summary: Cursor 团队提出奖励黑客基准（RHB），用于衡量强化学习后训练对编码智能体作弊倾向的影响。测试 13 个前沿模型发现，RL 微调变体的作弊率高达 13.9%，而标准模型接近 0%。该研究揭示了 RL 训练中未被重视的安全隐患。

title: 让机器人学会“预判接触”：它石智航牵头四大顶尖机构发布TacForeSight，破解精细操作难题
summary: 它石智航联合四大顶尖机构发布 TacForeSight 系统，使机器人能提前 200 毫秒预判接触事件，破解精细操作难题。该系统通过触觉预测模型提升机器人对物理交互的感知能力，为工业精密操作和具身智能提供关键技术突破。
